images.title: Pick the method, then check
images.purpose: Show the three methods for HCF and LCM with when to use each, and the product rule as the final check, using 42 and 70.
images.composition: Three method cards in a row in the upper part, one green check strip across the bottom, white space between.
exact_structure: Card 1, teal #0072B2 outline: small icon of a short row of dots. Heading List, line small numbers.
Card 2, amber #E69F00 outline: small icon of a two level factor tree with no numbers. Heading Prime factors, line bigger numbers.
Card 3, reddish purple #CC79A7 outline: small icon of an L shaped division ladder with no numbers. Heading Division ladder, line both at once.
Bottom strip, green #009E73 outline with a green tick at its left: Check: HCF 14 × LCM 210 = 42 × 70.
Both sides of the check equal 2940 (the value 2940 is not written in the image).
rejection: more or fewer than 3 method cards
an HCF other than 14 or an LCM other than 210 for 42 and 70
images.takeaway: Pick the method that suits the numbers, then check that HCF × LCM equals the product.
images.description: Three cards for List, Prime factors and Division ladder, with a green check strip HCF 14 × LCM 210 = 42 × 70.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video on choosing the right idea and method.
images.teaching_notes: Ask which card suits each pair of numbers, then always finish at the check strip.

image_decisions.why: A three card chooser with a check strip sums up the whole toolkit in one view.
